decisive_items: the mass appeared pinkish-yellow rather than the typical salmon pink of lymphoid lesions.
A linear, soft-tissue lesion was noted centrally along the lower conjunctival fornix of the right eye;
Orbital computed tomography demonstrated a purely conjunctival, homogeneous mass isodense to muscle without infiltration of adjacent structures.
response.rationale: The pinkish-yellow, non-salmon color, chronic foreign-body sensation, and homogeneous non-infiltrating conjunctival mass on CT are most consistent with conjunctival amyloidosis; lymphoma is directly contradicted by the color, and granuloma lacks supporting inflammatory or vascular features.

rejected.why: The lesion is explicitly pinkish-yellow rather than the typical salmon pink of lymphoid lesions, and there is no systemic or histologic evidence of lymphoma.
No granuloma-specific features such as inflammatory nodule, vascularity, bleeding, or inciting event are provided; the linear homogeneous mass and color favor amyloidosis.
